experiences.description: Hunayn Teknologi is an IT consulting company founded in 2023 and based in BSD Tangerang, Indonesia. It focuses on building digital solutions for the sharia finance sector, especially multi-tenant cooperative management systems.
experiences.descriptionId: Hunayn Teknologi adalah perusahaan konsultan IT yang didirikan pada 2023 dan berbasis di BSD Tangerang, Indonesia. Perusahaan ini berfokus membangun solusi digital untuk sektor keuangan syariah, terutama sistem manajemen koperasi multi-tenant.

projects.name: Syirkah Web Application
projects.description: Core multi-tenant Sharia cooperative system covering backend and frontend, designed with Clean Architecture to support scalability, security, and complex business processes.
projects.descriptionId: Sistem inti koperasi syariah multi-tenant yang mencakup backend dan frontend, dirancang dengan Clean Architecture untuk mendukung skalabilitas, keamanan, dan proses bisnis yang kompleks.
features: Arsitektur multi-tenant dengan pemisahan schema untuk setiap koperasi syariah
Fitur utama super admin untuk melakukan switch antar koperasi
Sistem migrasi database berbasis versi dengan pembaruan schema otomatis
Implementasi Clean Architecture di sisi backend
Sistem autentikasi aman dengan login, registrasi, dan Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
Manajemen hak akses berbasis role (RBAC) dengan permission yang granular
Modul manajemen koperasi yang lengkap (anggota, produk, cabang, role, dan konfigurasi)
Modul akuntansi dan keuangan meliputi chart of account, jurnal, buku besar, dan laporan keuangan
Manajemen siklus pembiayaan (pengajuan, persetujuan, realisasi, cicilan, dan perhitungan ulang)
Dashboard dan laporan untuk monitoring operasional dan keuangan
Manajemen konten dinamis per koperasi (logo, banner, konten, dan konfigurasi)
Generasi dokumen dan integrasi penyimpanan cloud (export PDF, storage)
Base CRUD reusable yang dioptimalkan untuk kebutuhan multi-tenant
Pengembangan UI frontend untuk dashboard, form, dan operasional koperasi
featuresEn: Multi-tenant architecture supporting multiple Sharia cooperatives with isolated schemas
Super admin capability to switch between cooperatives seamlessly
Version-based database migration system with automatic schema updates
Clean Architecture implementation across backend layers
Secure authentication system with login, registration, and Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
Role-based access control (RBAC) with granular permissions
Comprehensive cooperative management modules (members, products, branches, roles, and configurations)
Accounting and financial modules including chart of accounts, journals, ledger, and financial reports
Financing lifecycle management (request, approval, realization, installment, and recalculation)
Dashboard and reporting features for operational and financial insights
Dynamic content management per cooperative (logos, banners, content, and configurations)
Document generation and storage integration (PDF export, cloud storage)
Reusable base CRUD system optimized for multi-tenant environments
Frontend UI implementation for dashboards, forms, and cooperative operations

projects.name: Hunayn Ghazi - Core Backend
projects.description: Core backend service for a multi-tenant Sharia cooperative system, designed with Clean Architecture to ensure scalability, maintainability, and reusability across multiple applications.
projects.descriptionId: Backend inti untuk sistem koperasi syariah multi-tenant, dirancang dengan Clean Architecture untuk memastikan skalabilitas, kemudahan pemeliharaan, dan reusabilitas di berbagai aplikasi.
features: Modul backend inti yang reusable dan digunakan di berbagai proyek
Arsitektur database multi-tenant dengan isolasi berbasis skema
Implementasi Base CRUD generik menggunakan GORM
Migrasi Base CRUD dari GORM ke SQLX untuk performa dan kontrol yang lebih baik
Integrasi AWS S3 untuk penyimpanan file dan dokumen secara aman
Integrasi Azure Blob Storage sebagai alternatif penyimpanan
featuresEn: Reusable core backend modules shared across multiple projects
Multi-tenant database architecture with schema-based isolation
Generic Base CRUD implementation using GORM
Migration of Base CRUD from GORM to SQLX for better performance and control
Integration with AWS S3 for secure file and document storage
Integration with Azure Blob Storage as an alternative storage provider

projects.name: Sistem Informasi Akademik MIAN
projects.description: A web-based academic information system for Ma'had Imam An-Nawawi (MIAN) where students can access schedules, quizzes, attendance, learning materials, muroja'ah videos, profile, and payments through a modern mobile-first interface with API integration.
projects.descriptionId: Sistem informasi akademik berbasis web untuk Ma'had Imam An-Nawawi (MIAN) yang dirancang agar santri dapat mengakses jadwal, kuis, presensi, materi pembelajaran, video muroja'ah, profil, dan pembayaran melalui antarmuka modern dan responsif dengan pendekatan mobile-first serta integrasi API.
features: Autentikasi (login, register) dengan validasi bertahap, penanganan error, dan route protection
Beranda: jadwal, filter kuis/deadline, video muroja'ah, presensi (clock in/out), sapaan dinamis berdasarkan gender
Halaman kelas dengan kategori (reguler, arsip, Masdar, Mulakhash), detail kelas dengan tab jadwal, kuis, nilai/rapor, silabus, dan absensi
Detail pelajaran dengan konten rich text, dukungan teks Arab, zoom in/out, dan unduh silabus
Kuis: multiple choice, single choice, true/false, essay; logika retake, gambar di RTE, hasil dengan visualisasi skor
Profil: data pengguna, upload avatar, ubah password, ringkasan tagihan SPP dengan tab tanggungan & jatuh tempo
Halaman pembayaran SPP dengan sorting, filter, load more; payment gateway Doku dengan webhook n8n untuk handling callback dan notifikasi WhatsApp
Alur registrasi multi-step dengan komitmen dinamis dari Strapi, autocomplete alamat, pilihan kode telepon, dan field kondisional
Payment gateway Doku untuk biaya pendaftaran: workflow n8n untuk pembuatan pembayaran, handling callback Doku, pengecekan status otomatis, dan notifikasi WhatsApp (Watzap) setelah pembayaran berhasil
Dashboard Guru: manajemen kelas & pertemuan, absensi, nilai, hasil kuis, rich text editor, dark mode
Role Admin dengan autentikasi terpisah (Strapi Admin Panel), dashboard, dan layout responsif
e-Maktabah: daftar buku dengan pencarian, filter berdasarkan kursus/pelajaran, dan halaman detail PDF
Komponen reusable: Bottom Navigation, Tab Navigation, Skeleton Loading, Modal, ScoreCircle
Abstraksi service layer API, caching React Query, dan deployment CI/CD ke Cloudflare Pages
featuresEn: Authentication (login, register) with step validation, error handling, and route protection
Home page: schedule, quiz/deadline filter, muroja'ah video, attendance (clock in/out), dynamic greeting by gender
Class page with course categories, detail page with schedule, quiz, grades, syllabus, and attendance tabs
Lesson detail with rich text content, Arabic text support, zoom in/out, and syllabus download
Quiz: multiple choice, single choice, true/false, essay; retake logic, images in RTE, result with score visualization
Profile: user data, avatar upload, change password, SPP payment summary with responsibility & due date
SPP payment page with sorting, filter, load more; Doku payment gateway with n8n webhook callback and WhatsApp notification
Multi-step registration flow with dynamic commitments from Strapi, address autocomplete, phone code selector, and conditional fields
Doku payment gateway on registration: n8n workflow for payment creation, callback handling, auto status check, and WhatsApp notification (Watzap)
Teacher dashboard: class & lesson management, attendance, grades, quiz results, rich text editor, dark mode
Admin role with separate authentication (Strapi Admin Panel), dashboard, and responsive layout
e-Maktabah: book listing with search, filter by course/lesson, and PDF detail page
Reusable components: Bottom Navigation, Tab Navigation, Skeleton Loading, Modal, ScoreCircle
API service layer abstraction, React Query caching, and Cloudflare Pages CI/CD deployment
